import os
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from cyhole.solscan import SolscanV2

TOKEN_ADDRESS = "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111"  # replace with the target token's address

api_key = os.environ["SOLSCAN_API_KEY"]
solscan = SolscanV2(api_key=api_key)

end = datetime.now()
start = end - timedelta(days=30)

response = solscan.client.get_token_price(TOKEN_ADDRESS, (start, end))
